overview.designRule: Ragas must not be treated as generic pitch sets. Each raga card should present behavioural constraints: ascent/descent, melodic outline, strong/weak notes, phrase endings, drone and time/mood.
overview.firstScreenCopy: Choose a raga when you want a living melodic world, not just a scale. The app will respect ascent, descent, phrase grammar, emphasis and mood.
guardrails: Do not present a raga as only a scale.
Always show full source author and book title when a raga-derived idea appears.
Mark interpretation variance when source traditions differ.
Prefer contour, drone, phrase and mood over Western chord-scale usage.
Frame outputs as original Neon Orbit prompts, not classical-performance claims.
